title_en: Global Atom Topology (Staged Full-Canon) with Multi-Gate Robustness
abstract_en_180w: Global Atom Topology (Staged Full-Canon) with Multi-Gate Robustness. We transform high-complexity narrative corpora into atom-level structures and compute topological similarity beyond lexical overlap. The resulting network contains 7477 nodes and 3051269 gate-passed edges, with 1115 old-new cross edges and a detected phase-transition signal. Our robustness stack combines drift, negative-control, and counterfactual gates; integrated status is GO, and the mean base-minus-counterfactual gap is 0.362182. A staged full-canon run completed 5/5 stages under source mode verse_level_ingest. Methodologically, we follow three stages: atomize event-level candidates and assign symbolic sequence priors; build pairwise similarity matrix and gate-passed topological edges; run drift + negative-control + counterfactual gate stack before external reporting. Key limitations remain operational: N^2 similarity scaling requires staged expansion and compute budgeting, and 4D mapping can accumulate synchronization noise. High-complexity historical corpora are used as stress-test beds for context filtering robustness, not as doctrinal proof.
contributions_en: Introduces an atom-topology pipeline that maps event narratives to structure-level similarity beyond lexical overlap.
Demonstrates staged full-canon execution with measurable transition links and gated topology outputs.
Integrates drift, negative-control, and counterfactual gates into a reproducible robustness stack.
method_outline_en: Atomize event-level candidates and assign symbolic sequence priors.
Build pairwise similarity matrix and gate-passed topological edges.
Run drift + negative-control + counterfactual gate stack before external reporting.
risk_notes_en: N^2 similarity scaling requires staged expansion and compute budgeting.
4D mapping can accumulate synchronization noise; ablation and counterfactual checks remain mandatory.
